scenario: LGRA.2.9.6.8 — the `call … as` correlation is interpolation-eligible: `as "rsvp-{s.obj}"` substitutes at runtime into the correlation delivered to the integrator (a String-valued <expr> per LRST.1.4). Pin: the call reaches the cb with correlation `rsvp-engine.o`.
rules_ds:
service svc.do:
    kwarg line: String
    no response

schema Src scope logical:
    obj: String key

rule r:
    Src s
->
    call svc.do line: "cc {s.obj}" nocooldown as "rsvp-{s.obj}"
